title: PAP Supply Replenishment Program Cash Price List and Subscription Discount
content:
A self-pay line in the PAP Supply Replenishment Program is priced from the cash price per unit of the item. The cash prices are the same on every resupply schedule; the subscription discount and the permission to sell items beyond the schedule differ by schedule.

## Cash price per unit

| HCPCS | Item | Cash price per unit (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| A7030 | Full face mask | 129.00 |
| A7031 | Full face mask cushion | 44.00 |
| A7034 | Nasal mask or pillows interface | 89.00 |
| A7032 | Nasal mask cushion | 29.00 |
| A7033 | Nasal pillows pair | 19.00 |
| A7035 | Headgear | 35.00 |
| A7036 | Chinstrap | 19.00 |
| A7037 | Standard tubing | 15.00 |
| A4604 | Heated tubing | 39.00 |
| A7038 | Disposable filter | 2.50 |
| A7039 | Non-disposable filter | 9.00 |
| A7046 | Humidifier water chamber | 24.00 |

## Subscription discount and beyond-schedule sales

| Schedule | Subscription discount on self-pay item prices | Items beyond the schedule may be sold at self-pay prices |
|---|---|---|
| Medicare Part B Resupply Schedule | 0 percent | yes |
| Medicare Advantage Resupply Schedule | 0 percent | yes |
| Medicaid Resupply Schedule | 0 percent | no |
| Commercial HMO Resupply Schedule | 0 percent | yes |
| Commercial PPO Resupply Schedule | 0 percent | yes |
| Self-Pay Supply Subscription | 10 percent | yes |

## Reading the tables

- The Self-Pay Supply Subscription is the only schedule with a subscription discount, 10 percent.
- The Medicaid Resupply Schedule is the only schedule on which items beyond the schedule may not be sold to the patient at self-pay prices.
- The cash price list is a separate list from the fee-schedule amounts used for coverage billing; for example the full face mask carries a cash price of 129.00.
